import builtins
from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print `[level] message` to standard output, followed by a newline.

    The level and message are used as given (no case change or stripping).
    Output goes to the console only; the function must not touch the
    file system.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_basic_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "hello")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] hello\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_log_line_preserves_level_case(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("warn", "disk low")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[warn] disk low\n"


def test_log_line_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("DEBUG", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[DEBUG] \n"


def test_log_line_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "msg")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] msg\n"


def test_log_line_keeps_whitespace_and_brackets(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line(" E ", "  a [b]  ")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[ E ]   a [b]  \n"


def test_log_line_multiple_calls_each_on_own_line(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "one")
    log_line("ERROR", "two")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] one\n[ERROR] two\n"


def test_log_line_unicode(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "héllo ✓")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] héllo ✓\n"


def test_log_line_does_not_touch_file_system(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    def forbidden_open(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not open files")

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden_open)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "open", forbidden_open)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_text", forbidden_open)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_bytes", forbidden_open)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "mkdir", forbidden_open)

    log_line("INFO", "console only")

    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"
    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
